title: Quadrilaterals
description: Learn quadrilaterals for Class 3: recognize squares, rectangles, rhombuses, trapezoids and parallelograms. Understand why a square is a special rectangle.

topics.title: Recognize Quadrilaterals
topics.concept:
A quadrilateral is any closed shape with exactly 4 sides and 4 angles.

  • Square: 4 equal sides, 4 right angles
  • Rectangle: Opposite sides equal, 4 right angles
  • Rhombus: 4 equal sides, opposite angles equal (no right angles)
  • Trapezoid: Exactly 1 pair of parallel sides
  • Parallelogram: 2 pairs of parallel sides, opposite sides equal

examples.problem: Which quadrilateral has 4 equal sides AND 4 right angles?
examples.solution: A square. It is the only quadrilateral with both properties.

examples.problem: Which quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
examples.solution: A trapezoid. It has one pair of parallel sides (the two bases) and one pair that is not parallel.

examples.problem: Which has opposite sides parallel but no right angles?
examples.solution: A parallelogram or rhombus. Opposite sides are parallel and equal, but corners are not 90°.

recap: Square and rectangle: 4 right angles. Rhombus: 4 equal sides.
Trapezoid: 1 pair parallel. Parallelogram: 2 pairs parallel.

topics.title: A Square is a Special Rectangle
topics.concept:
Think of shapes as a family — some shapes belong to more than one group.

  • Every rectangle has: 4 right angles + opposite sides equal
  • Every square has: 4 right angles + ALL sides equal

Since a square meets all the rules of a rectangle AND has equal sides, every square is a rectangle. But not every rectangle is a square (unless all sides are equal).

examples.solution: Yes. A square has 4 right angles and opposite sides equal — it meets all rectangle requirements. Plus all sides are equal.
No. A rectangle only needs opposite sides equal. If the sides are not all equal, it is not a square.

examples.problem: Name a shape that is always a square AND always a rectangle.
examples.solution: A square! Every square is a rectangle. But only squares with all sides equal qualify as squares.

recap: Every square is a rectangle. Not every rectangle is a square.
A square belongs to: quadrilaterals, parallelograms, rectangles, rhombuses.

questions.q: How many sides does a quadrilateral have?

questions.explanation: Both square and rhombus have 4 equal sides. Square also has 4 right angles; rhombus does not.
Square and rectangle both have 4 right angles (90° each).
A square is a special rectangle — it has all the properties of a rectangle plus equal sides.

questions.q: Which quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
questions.explanation: A trapezoid has exactly one pair of parallel sides. The other pair is not parallel.

questions.q: Which shape has opposite sides parallel?
questions.explanation: A parallelogram has 2 pairs of parallel sides. Squares and rectangles are special parallelograms.

options: Only if it has right angles
Only if all sides are equal
questions.explanation: Yes. A rhombus has 2 pairs of parallel sides, so it is a parallelogram.
Yes. A rectangle has 2 pairs of parallel sides, so it is a parallelogram.

questions.q: Which quadrilateral is ALWAYS also a rectangle?
questions.explanation: Every square is a rectangle. Squares have all of rectangle's properties plus equal sides.

questions.q: A parallelogram with 4 right angles is called a?
questions.explanation: A parallelogram with 4 right angles is a rectangle. If sides are also equal, it is a square.

questions.q: A quadrilateral has 4 equal sides but NO right angles. What is it?
questions.explanation: 4 equal sides + no right angles = rhombus. A square has right angles too.

questions.q: A square has side 5 cm. A rectangle has the same perimeter. If rectangle length = 7 cm, width = ?
Which quadrilaterals have diagonals that are equal in length?
questions.explanation: Square and rectangle both have equal diagonals. Rhombus diagonals are not equal (unless it is a square).

questions.q: A shape has opposite sides equal and parallel, but angles are NOT 90°. It is a?
questions.explanation: Opposite sides parallel and equal + angles not 90° = parallelogram (not a rectangle or square).

questions.q: How many quadrilaterals have 4 right angles?
questions.explanation: Only square and rectangle have 4 right angles. Other quadrilaterals may have different angles.

questions.q: A parallelogram has angles 110°, 70°, 110°, 70°. All sides equal. What is this shape?
questions.explanation: Parallelogram with all 4 sides equal = rhombus. Since angles are not 90°, it is not a square.
